// Fixture de l'auto-test : chaque ligne marquee VIOLATION doit etre signalee par
// check_selection_single_mutator.cmake (et AUCUNE autre).
// SELECTION-MUTATOR:BEGIN
void W::setSelection(Selection s) { selectedObject_ = s.id; }
// SELECTION-MUTATOR:END

void W::bad() {
    selectedObject_ = x; // VIOLATION assignation
    selectedRegion_.reset(); // VIOLATION reset
    multiSelection_.clear(); // VIOLATION clear
    multiSelection_.push_back(x); // VIOLATION push_back
    multiSelection_.emplace_back(x); // VIOLATION emplace_back
    multiSelection_.pop_back(); // VIOLATION pop_back
    multiSelection_.erase(multiSelection_.begin()); // VIOLATION erase
    multiSelection_.insert(multiSelection_.end(), x); // VIOLATION insert
    auto& alias = selectedRegion_; // VIOLATION alias reference
    auto* ptr = &multiSelection_; // VIOLATION pointeur
    multiSelection_ // VIOLATION appel coupe sur deux lignes
        .push_back(x);
    multiSelection_.back() = x; // VIOLATION back()=
    multiSelection_[0] = x; // VIOLATION [i]=
    multiSelection_.at(0) = x; // VIOLATION at()=
    selectedObject_.value() = x; // VIOLATION value()=
    selectedObject_->value = 3; // VIOLATION ->champ=
    std::sort(multiSelection_.begin(), multiSelection_.end()); // VIOLATION sort
    std::erase_if(multiSelection_, pred); // VIOLATION erase_if
    std::ranges::reverse(multiSelection_); // VIOLATION ranges::reverse
    std::exchange(selectedRegion_, y); // VIOLATION exchange
    std::swap(selectedEmbroidery_, other); // VIOLATION swap
    auto moved = std::move(multiSelection_); // VIOLATION move
    /* commentaire */ selectedObject_ = x; // VIOLATION apres commentaire bloc
    /* commentaire
       sur deux lignes */ selectedObject_.reset(); // VIOLATION apres commentaire multi-lignes
    *selectedObject_ = x; // VIOLATION deref=
    for (auto& id : multiSelection_) {} // VIOLATION range-for non const
    auto fn = [&selectedObject_]() {}; // VIOLATION capture par reference
    auto r = std::ref(selectedRegion_); // VIOLATION std::ref
    selectedObject_ += 1; // VIOLATION operateur compose
    ++multiSelection_.back().value; // VIOLATION pre-increment
    multiSelection_.back().value++; // VIOLATION post-increment
    multiSelection_.swap(other); // VIOLATION swap membre
    selectedEmbroidery_ = // VIOLATION affectation dont la valeur est sur la ligne suivante
        z;
}
